class.name: State
class.brief_description: Carries layout state between layout passes.
class.description: State is an internal port of [i]RecyclerView.State[/i]: it carries layout state between the pre-layout and the final layout pass (item counts, target scroll position, layout step). You normally do not touch it; it exists so LayoutManagers can read counts and flags during layout.

method.name: did_structure_change
method.description: Returns whether the data structure changed since the last layout.

method.name: get_deleted_invisible_item_count_since_previous_layout
method.description: Returns how many invisible items were deleted since the previous layout.

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns the current item count (adjusted for invisible removed items during pre-layout).

method.name: get_layout_step
method.description: Returns the current layout step.

method.name: get_previous_layout_item_count
method.description: Returns the item count from the previous layout.

method.name: get_target_scroll_position
method.description: Returns the requested target scroll position.

method.name: has_target_scroll_position
method.description: Returns whether a target scroll position was requested.

method.name: is_measuring
method.description: Returns whether the RecyclerView is in measuring state.

method.name: is_pre_layout
method.description: Returns whether the current pass is the pre-layout.

method.name: prepare_for_nested_prefetch
method.description: Resets layout state for a nested prefetch.

method.name: set_deleted_invisible_item_count_since_previous_layout
method.description: Sets the count of invisible deleted items.

method.name: set_item_count
method.description: Sets the item count.

method.name: set_layout_step
method.description: Sets the layout step.

method.name: set_measuring
method.description: Sets the measuring state.

method.name: set_pre_layout
method.description: Sets the pre-layout flag.

method.name: set_previous_layout_item_count
method.description: Sets the previous layout item count.

method.name: set_run_predictive_animations
method.description: Sets the predictive-animation flag.

method.name: set_run_simple_animations
method.description: Sets the simple-animation flag.

method.name: set_structure_changed
method.description: Sets the structure-changed flag.

method.name: set_target_scroll_position
method.description: Sets the requested target scroll position.

method.name: will_run_predictive_animations
method.description: Returns whether predictive animations will run.

method.name: will_run_simple_animations
method.description: Returns whether simple animations will run.
